From Wiktionary, the free dictionary
See also: Demonio, demónio, and demônio

Ilocano

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Spanish demonio.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /deˈmonjo/ [deˈmo.ɲo]
  • Hyphenation: de‧mo‧nio

Noun

[edit]

demonio

  1. demon; devil

Italian

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • dimonio (literary, dialectal)
  • dimogno (semi-learned, dialectal)

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Latin daemonium, from Ancient Greek δαιμόνιον (daimónion), diminutive of δαίμων (daímōn, “god, divine power”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /deˈmɔ.njo/
  • Rhymes: -ɔnjo
  • Hyphenation: de‧mò‧nio
  • Audio:(file)

Noun

[edit]

demonio m (plural demoni)

  1. demon, devil

Related terms

[edit]
  • Demonio
  • demone
  • pandemonio
  • indemoniato

Anagrams

[edit]
  • monodie, monoide

Portuguese

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

demonio m (plural demonios)

  1. pre-reform spelling (used until 1943 in Brazil and 1911 in Portugal) of demônio / demónio

Spanish

[edit]
Spanish Wikipedia has an article on:
demonio
Wikipedia es

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Latin daemonium, from Ancient Greek δαιμόνιον (daimónion), diminutive of δαίμων (daímōn, “god, divine power”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /deˈmonjo/ [d̪eˈmo.njo]
  • Rhymes: -onjo
  • Syllabification: de‧mo‧nio

Noun

[edit]

demonio m (plural demonios)

  1. demon, devil
    Synonym: diablo

Derived terms

[edit]
  • cómo demonios
  • como un demonio
  • de mil demonios
  • demonio de Maxwell
  • demonio de Tasmania
  • demonización
  • demonizar
  • endemoniado
  • endemoniar

Related terms

[edit]
  • demoníaco

Descendants

[edit]
  • → Ilocano: demonio
  • → Karao: dimonyo
  • → Tagalog: demonyo

Further reading

[edit]
  • “demonio”, in Diccionario de la lengua española [Dictionary of the Spanish Language] (in Spanish), online version 23.8.1, Royal Spanish Academy [Spanish: Real Academia Española], 15 December 2025

Tagalog

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Standard Tagalog) IPA(key): /deˈmonjo/ [d̪ɛˈmoː.ɲo]
    • IPA(key): (no palatal assimilation) /deˈmonjo/ [d̪ɛˈmon̪.jo]
  • Rhymes: -onjo
  • Syllabification: de‧mon‧io

Noun

[edit]

demonio (Baybayin spelling ᜇᜒᜋᜓᜈ᜔ᜌᜓ)

  1. obsolete spelling of demonyo
